speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Are you insane, you can't just break into a woman's apartment in the middle of the night and clean.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I had no choice. I couldn't sleep knowing that just outside my bedroom was our living room, and just outside our living room was that hallway, and immediately adjacent to that hallway was... this.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Do you realize that if Penny wakes up, there is no reasonable explanation as to why we're here?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I just gave you a reasonable explanation.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, no. You gave me an explanation, it's reasonableness will be determined by a jury of your peers.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't be ridiculous. I have no peers.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, we have to get out of here.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You might want to speak in a lower register.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Evolution has made women sensitive to high pitched noises while they sleep, so that they'll be roused by a crying baby. If you want to avoid waking her, speak in a lower register.
